title: Small CLs
author: Google Engineering Practices
version: 2026-11-14; the address is the publisher's canonical page and was not fetched in this container

record.source: A change should be small and self-contained: one thing, reviewable in one sitting, with unrelated changes and cleanups left out so the review can see the feature.
record.kept: Self-containment, and the exclusion of unrelated churn from a change.
record.rewritten: The size measure. Google sizes a change in lines and review minutes; this repository sizes a unit by outcome -- one roadmap task, one delivery commit -- because a mass rename or a regenerated file breaks any line count while remaining one unit.
record.added: The record case: a record created and retired inside the series is churn, so the property applies to `.agents/` and `devlog/` as much as to source.
record.dropped: The line-count threshold and the review-time target.
